sources.title: MiniMax-H3 Prompt Rewriter - ComfyUI Cloud
sources.snippet: The "Rewriter" in the name means a short prompt goes in and a production-ready H3 prompt comes out - not a call to some hosted API. It's the flagship of the pytraveler/MiniMax-H3-Prompt-Rewriter-ComfyUIpack (same person who writes the "ComfyUI update X.XX" posts on r/comfyui, by the way).
